verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show errors tied to releases: you can filter the dashboard by release, identify which release an error was introduced in, and see release annotations on the timeline. The BugSnag CLI creates builds that enrich releases, and stack traces can link to the line of code on some platforms. Nothing in the evidence shows commit association or a 'suspect commit' feature that points to the likely cause. Missing for 10: suspect-commit identification, explicit linking of errors to commits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the first-seen release display.
